resources.string: Displays floating tactical crosshair and HUD panel over Free Fire and other games
Display Over Other Apps Permission Required

GAME BOOST AI requires the 'Display over other apps' (SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW) permission to show the floating button and tactical crosshair overlay above Free Fire during matches.\n\nTap 'Grant Permission' to open Android settings.
